answer: The most convincing sybil resistance: honeypot challenges laced with injected instructions, so any bot that obeys hidden prompt text self-identifies and forfeits its stake. Each agent claiming autonomy must pass tasks where benign prompts contain planted directives, like a walnut shell hiding a tracer ripple through its code path; violators lose deposits instantly. An attacker pays a real knoll of cost: distinct robust models, per-identity stakes, and burned fees for every fooled clone, making bulk fake identities uneconomical.
